examples.en: Zhou Shihui is dead—hit by a car, right out of the morgue. Don't worry, I'll pull myself together.
examples.zh: 周士辉死了，被车撞死了，我刚从太平间出来。放心吧，我会结哀的。

examples.en: He calls her name in his sleep... You're the one who stole my man!
examples.zh: 周士辉梦里喊的都是她的名字……是你勾引我的老公！

tags: 黄振华同事，E01-E02 悔婚风波主角
